contents.text: {"hypotheses":[{"experiment_id":"carry","text":"If Kai Nakamura had carried the ball forward instead of shooting, his chance to score would have increased (carrying creates a better shooting opportunity)."},{"experiment_id":"pass_A11","text":"If Kai Nakamura had passed to Bastian Holt (LM) instead of shooting, the chance to score would have been higher (the LM would have had a better-angle/less-pressured chance)."}]}
